nina (AE): Heads-up: ran BlueHorizon POC bench this morning. Posting top-line so sales can draft an estimate + sec answers.

sam (eng-runtime): Good — what load shapes did you run?

nina (AE): Two profiles: short (<=48 tokens) and mixed (avg 300 tokens with some 1200-token tails). Short: sustained 250 QPS for 20m, median ~48ms, p95 ~95ms, p99 ~180ms. Mixed: sustained 75 QPS for 15m, median ~410ms, p95 ~720ms, p99 ~1.05s.

alisha (eng-platform): Infra: 2-model-replica pool on 2xA40 nodes, autoscaling off. Batching mode: adaptive, target_batch=8, KV cache ON. Single-replica failover tested too.

sam (eng-runtime): Model profile: LoRA fine-tuned variant, int8 quantized for perf runs. Also ran a quality pass at fp16 — no meaningful diff on their 500-sample eval.

dev-bot: Load job created by nina at 2025-12-02T09:12:24Z. Driver: rload v1.0.2.

nina (AE): Command: `rload --profile mixed --target 250 --concurrency 48 --duration 1200 --prompts bluehorizon_set.json`

alisha (eng-platform): Observations: warmup transient ~70s due to model mmap and KV population. Adaptive batching hit target_batch ~6 avg. We saw token-level throughput jitter when two 1200-token requests overlapped; added a token-limit gate on client side fixed the spike.

quentin (security): They raised two items on the questionnaire: 1) key residency + KMS provider, 2) audit log retention and access controls. Measured KMS decrypt latency (AWS KMS) was ~9ms per session during handshake. Note: if they require FIPS attested HSM, we'll need Private deployment + HSM config.

harry (finance): Pricing ask: customer asked for an OPEX estimate for 120M tokens/month (70% short, 30% mixed). Want a monthly price we can quote.

sam (eng-runtime): Quick calc: with int8 profile, effective tokens/sec per GPU ~2.8k for short-heavy mix. 120M tokens/mo => ~400k tokens/day => ~16.7k tokens/hr avg => ~6 GPU-hours/day => ~180 GPU-hours/mo. Add ~25% infra+network overhead => ~225 GPU-hours/mo. I'll produce a precise spreadsheet.

ella (solutions): Proposal options we should include: Option 1: Single-AZ reserved (7 GPUs) with canary replica. Option 2: Multi-AZ active-passive (9 GPUs pre-warmed standby). Include expected p95s and incremental cost for standby. Also include note on E2E SLOs and incident runbook.

harry (finance): Also add annual commit discount line and +/- pricing for payg vs reserved.

quentin (security): For the questionnaire: I'll prepare answers for KMS integration and audit logs. Need to confirm whether BlueHorizon requires HSM attestation and specific retention period for logs (they mentioned 7 vs 90 days).

alisha (eng-platform): Failover note: active-passive failover measured added ~180-240ms to p95 during handoff. Pre-warmed standby reduces that to ~40-60ms but costs ~18% more reserved capacity. We simulated AZ loss with the command: `kubectl label nodes -l zone=us-east-2a evict=true` then drained traffic.

nina (AE): Action items: 1) sam - perf CSV + tokens->GPU-hours calc (EOD). 2) alisha - post failover logs & exact warm-standby delta (tomorrow). 3) quentin - draft questionnaire answers + ask about HSM attestation requirement (tomorrow). 4) ella/harry - two pricing options + TCO slide (Mon).

sam (eng-runtime): I'll attach the small conversion script and perf CSV once cleaned. Script sample: ```python
# quick tokens->gpu-hours calc
def gpu_hours(tokens_per_month, tok_per_sec_per_gpu):
    secs = (int(tokens_per_month)/tok_per_sec_per_gpu)
    hrs = secs/3600
    return hrs
```

dev-bot: Load job finished at 2025-12-02T09:32:24Z. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/bluehorizon/1752223344/run.log

nina (AE): Thanks all. If we can get numbers + sec answers by Monday we can run the quoting call Tuesday.

quentin (security): One more: recommend adding CP-SSO checkbox on signup and a short blurb on KMS provider selection to the onboarding form to catch residency early.

nina (AE): Added to action list. Closing thread for updates as attachments are posted.
